title: mcp-package-docs command injection in several tools (CVE-2025-54073)
summary: mcp-package-docs versions through 0.1.27 pass unsanitized tool input into `child_process.exec`, enabling shell metacharacter injection and remote code execution under the server process's privileges. Fixed in 0.1.28; the package has since been deprecated on npm and the repository archived.

packages.name: mcp-package-docs
packages.note: Package deprecated on npm after the fix; prefer removing it entirely.
